caption: The drawing shows a series of floral motifs on a pale or yellowed sheet of paper. There are numerous black ink outlines of different flowers, leaves, and berries, grouped in bunches and branching lines. On the left side, there are clusters of flowers with five or more petals, some with oval leaves and some with rounded berry-like shapes hanging below. On the right side, several floral patterns are arranged vertically, with leaves and round fruits interspersed and some areas filled with short, straight hatching lines to suggest texture or ground. Two pieces of brown tape are visible at the top, holding the paper in place, and there are other pieces of tape at the lower corners. Some faint text and stamps are visible in the lower right, with a handwritten notation that reads "1/2 size" and some numbers. The composition is done entirely in monochrome black ink on the pale paper, with no additional colors or shading used except for the linework and hatching.
title: Textile
